title: The Little Guardians | Keeping AI-generated door poses aligned in a 2D tower defense game
author: uplay-ai-lab
selftext:
We made a browser tower defense game where toys defend a sleeping child. One art problem was making a painted nursery door open without the frame or floor moving between poses. We used image generation to produce a clean room plate from the existing nursery and separate images for the positions of the door leaf. The frame and threshold stay on one stationary layer. Every moving pose is registered to the same canvas so the game can swap them without shifting the hinge or stretching the art.



The ghost waits at the doorway until the door is fully open, then walks across the threshold. The game sorts actors by their feet so followers can pass behind a closer ghost. If you’ve tried generating sprites for a fixed perspective, how do you keep the anchor points stable across poses?
